content.title: ‘XO, Kitty’ Season 3 teases Kitty’s senior year — and a sister cameo
content.text: March 11, 2026Updated April 1, 2026, 6:32 p.m. ETKitty Song Covey's determined to make senior year count, come hell or high water."XO, Kitty" fans got a sneak peek at Kitty's senior year, which may or may not include a Lara Jean cameo, in the Season 3 teaser for the spinoff, which premieres April 2.Inspired by a character featured in the "To All the Boys" book and film trilogy, "XO, Kitty" chronicles Kitty's journey to Seoul, South Korea, the birthplace of her late mother and home to her long-distance boyfriend.Kitty is returning to Korean Independent School of Seoul (KISS), where she's fallen in love (more than once), made lifelong friends and put her matchmaking skills to good use, with her "perfect senior year mapped out.""I am so excited for senior year," Kitty says in the trailer. "There's still so many things I want to do before my time at KISS is over."Between making big decisions about her future and creating meaningful memories with her friends, accomplishing the tasks on her Senior Sunset list will prove to be more difficult than she thinks, especially when "surprise revelations throw her plans, and relationships, off course."A synopsis from Netflix reads: "Kitty will have to learn to embrace the unexpected."Watch it here: Stream your favorite shows, the biggest blockbusters and more.More Jenny Han: 'To All the Boys I've Loved Before' author's favorite book as a young adult will surprise youHere's everything we know about "XO, Kitty" Season 3, including how to watch.Watch 'XO, Kitty' Season 3 trailerMin Ho, others return for 'XO, Kitty' Season 3Familiar faces (and a few new ones) will round out the senior class, including:Kitty Song Covey (Anna Cathcart)Min Ho (Sang Heon Lee)Yuri (Gia Kim)Dae (Choi Min-yeong)Q (Anthony Keyvan), Juliana (Regan Aliyah), Jin (Joshua Lee), Madison (Jocelyn Shelfo), Eunice (Han Bi Ryu), Mihee (Sunny Oh) and Praveena (Sasha Bhasin) are also back at KISS for their senior year.Other characters returning include: Jiwon (Hojo Shin), Alex (Peter Thurnwald), Professor Lee (Michael K. Lee) and Mr. Moon (Philippe Lee).Marius (Sule Thelwell), Yisoo (Soy Kim) and Gigi (Christine Hwang) are joining the "XO, Kitty" cast for Season 3.'XO, Kitty' Season 3 release date"XO, Kitty" Season 3 premieres Thursday, April 2 on Netflix. All Season 3 episodes will drop on premiere day.
